PreInvocation.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_ANTIGRAVITY_EVENT='PreInvocation' /bin/sh "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi

PostInvocation.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_ANTIGRAVITY_EVENT='PostInvocation' /bin/sh "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi

Stop.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_ANTIGRAVITY_EVENT='Stop' /bin/sh "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi

hooks.command: if [ -x "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_ANTIGRAVITY_EVENT='PostToolUse' /bin/sh "$HOME/.orca/agent-hooks/antigravity-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi

Stop.command: command -v traces >/dev/null 2>&1 && traces hook agent agent-done --agent antigravity >/dev/null 2>&1; printf %s '{"decision":""}'
